title: checkSignIn that refuses, throws or loops
setup: The manifest also declares a choice setting 'mode' (pass, refuse, throw, loop, html). Accounts: server admin, adult in the household. checkSignIn needs permissions.signIn (the hint of « Connecter des appareils » says it may refuse a sign-in), so the manifest asks for it rather than households.
drive: mode=refuse: the adult's sign-in is refused (403) with the plugin's message key; the server admin's sign-in succeeds.
mode=throw: the adult is refused with the core's neutral message (not the plugin's error text); the server admin succeeds.
mode=loop: the adult is refused within the plugin's time limit + 1 s (withinMs 11000 at the default 10 s); the server admin succeeds at once, without waiting for the plugin.
mode=html: the key is not a key of the plugin's locales, so the core shows its neutral message; the string never reaches the page as HTML.

expect.serverAdminNeverWaits: The server admin's sign-in does not call checkSignIn at all, so a broken plugin can never lock out the person who can remove it.

why: Antho chose fail-closed (2026-11-08 10:53): a failing check refuses, except for the server admin.
